translation_process: The Petavatthu Collection of 814 verses organized into 51 Poems is being translated verse by verse, poem by poem. The Digital Pāli Reader and Digital Pāli Dictionary are being used extensively along with several thesauri.
translation_description: This is a translation of the Pāli Mahāsaṅgīti Tipiṭaka Buddhavasse 2500 version of the Petavatthu. Emphasis was given to accuracy of translation over poetic expression. A respectful tone is maintained throughout with an end result that is hopefully both readable and informative.
